title: Independent Richards Head-Budget Scale Characterization from Disjoint Temporal Evidence

reference_relationship.interpretation: The indicator is substantially and variably conservative relative to the available finite-reference discrepancy. This evidence does not establish a fixed conversion from B_inf to nonlinear true temporal error and therefore cannot itself define an application H_budget.

qualified_claims.observed_combined_scale_order: approximately 0.03 to 0.18 cm over the frozen independent matrices
